courses.note: Elective for the BS in Computer Science (the CS BS requires no AI/ML course; the BS in Artificial Intelligence requires CSE 150A or 150B and CSE 151A). Chosen as the intro ML course offered most often: it ran in Fall 2025 (two sections), Winter 2026, Spring 2026 and Summer 2026 on the department listings. CSE 150A is the other intro AI course. Other recent 151A offerings point to instructors' personal pages without a syllabus; the Fall 2026 course page lists large language models as a topic but states no AI-use rule.

notes: Frame from the UCSD 2025-26 catalog (BS Computer Science, CSE): lower division 'CSE 8B or CSE 11, CSE 12, ...'; upper-division core lists data structures CSE 100, algorithms CSE 101, software engineering CSE 110. C2 follows the rule 'next required programming course after C1' (CSE 12); CSE 100 is the later data structures course. CSE 12 has no public syllabus.
